title: HTRC C240 Battery Chargers Recalled Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Risk of Serious Injury and Death; Manufactured by Shenzhen Haitan Technology Co.
summary: The chargers can ignite or cause a connected battery to ignite, posing fire and burn hazards and risk of serious injury and death. Units: About 34,600.

title: Mr. Christmas Recalls Wireless Decorative Tree Light Controllers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The wireless receiver that plugs into an outlet can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 44,600.

title: Stanley Recalls 2.6 Million Switchback and Trigger Action Travel Mugs Due to Burn Hazard
summary: These mug's lid threads can shrink when exposed to heat and torque, causing the lid to detach during use, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 2.6 million.

title: Touch of Class® Recalls Wall Teester Bed Crowns Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The welded metal tabs used to mount the recalled bed crowns can weaken, causing the bed crown to fall from the wall onto consumers below, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 890.

title: Yoto Reannounces Recall of Yoto Mini Speakers for Children Due to Burn and Fire Hazards; New Full Battery Replacement Kit Now Available
summary: The speaker's lithium-ion battery can overheat and catch fire, posing burn and fire hazards to consumers. Units: About 251,165 (In addition, about 18,932 were sold in Canada) (The speakers were previously recalled in April 2024.).

title: Academy Sports + Outdoors Recalls Redfield 12- and 18-Gun Fireproof Safes Due to Serious Injury Hazard and Risk of Death
summary: The mechanical internal locking plates can fail to align and allow unauthorized users to open the gun safes, posing a serious injury hazard and risk of death. Units: About 6,100.

title: Anker Soundcore Lithium-Ion Battery Powered Bluetooth Speakers Recalled Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com by Anker Innovations
summary: The lithium-ion batteries in the recalled A3102 Anker Soundcore (black) and A3302 PowerConf S3 Bluetooth Speakers can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 69,000 (In addition, about 9,764 were sold in Canada).

title: Belkin Recalls Portable Wireless Battery Chargers for Smart Watches Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The lithium-ion batteries in the recalled power banks can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 4,000 (In addition, about 62 were sold in Canada).

title: NetZero USA Recalls High Bay LED Light Fixtures Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The plastic pins securing the LED light fixture can degrade, allowing the electrically charged LED board to come loose and contact items nearby that can catch fire, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 13,000.

title: Polaris Recalls Ranger Recreational Off-Road Vehicles and ProXD and Bobcat Utility Task Vehicles Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The vehicles' passenger side seat belt anchor point can separate from the frame due to a defective weld on the bracket, posing an injury hazard to passengers from impact with a loose bracket or failure of the seatbelt during a crash. Units: About 2,500 (In addition, about 130 were sold in Canada).

title: Polaris Recalls RZR XP 1000 and XP 4 1000 Recreational Off-Road Vehicles (ROVs) Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The positive (+) battery terminal cover (red) can become damaged by the seat base, causing the positive (+) battery post to be exposed and contact nearby conductive components, resulting in an electrical short, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 21,000 (In addition, about 1,300 were sold in Canada).

title: QVC Recalls More than One Million Temp-tations Oven Gloves Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The oven gloves can fail to provide sufficient protection from heat, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 1.1 million pairs of gloves.

title: Vacation Recalls The Legendary VACATION by Vacation® Black Label Scented Candles Due to Fire and Laceration Hazards
summary: The flame can burn too high and cause the glass container to break, posing fire and laceration hazards. Units: About 13,000.

title: BCI Burke Recalls Playground Merry-Go-Rounds Due to Crush Hazard
summary: The space between the rotating platform and the stationary outer rim can leave a gap that narrows too much, posing a crushing hazard to children. Units: About 415 (In addition, about 6 were sold in Canada).

title: Black Diamond Equipment Recalls PIEPS Pro IPS Avalanche Transceivers Due to Risk of Loss of Emergency Communications
summary: The battery compartment within the avalanche transceiver could not have enough contact force to supply power. title: GIKPAL Dressers Recalled Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Violations of Federal Regulation for Clothing Storage Units; Sold Exclusively on Walmart.com by ONME Direct
summary: The recalled dressers are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in injuries or death to children. The dressers violate performance and warning label requirements of the STURDY Act. Units: About 800.

title: Precor Recalls Resolute™ Cable Multi-Station Exercise Equipment Due to Impact Injury Hazard
summary: The pop-pin can fail to fully engage in the exercise equipment's vertical rail and cause the pulley carriage to drop unexpectedly during use, posing an impact injury hazard to users. Units: About 834.

title: Charmast Power Banks Recalled Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Sold by Charmast Exclusively on Amazon.com
summary: The lithium-ion battery in the recalled power banks can overheat and ignite, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 488,000.

title: Chervon North America Recalls SKIL 40V 5.0Ah Lithium-Ion Batteries for SKIL Lawnmowers and Outdoor Tools Due to Fire and Burn Hazard
summary: The lithium-ion batteries can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 63,000 (In addition, about 359 in Canada).

title: Magnetic Building Sticks Sets Recalled Due to Ingestion Hazard; Violation of Federal Regulations for Toy Magnets; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com by Elongdi
summary: The recalled magnetic building sticks set violates the mandatory federal regulation for magnet toys posing an ingestion hazard. title: Melii Baby Silicone Spoons for Babies Recalled Due to Choking Hazard; Imported by Melii Baby
summary: The silicone spoon can break apart while in use, posing a choking hazard to babies. Units: About 85,100.
